cohort: 790 pregnant women who underwent cesarean section between 2013 and 2016
finding: Morbidly obese women undergoing cesarean section had an increased likelihood of fetal distress, PACU admission, longer anesthesia puncture times, and other pregnancy complications.
mod_finding: General anesthesia, epidural anesthesia, and combined spinal-epidural anesthesia were found to be safe and effective in both severely and morbidly obese patients undergoing cesarean section.
